title: Pumas are protecting human lives by preventing vehicle collisions accounting for a 76% reduction in accidents
summary_full: Pumas in Washington's Olympic Peninsula play a crucial role in decreasing deer-related accidents on highways. By changing deer movement patterns to avoid roads and nighttime activities, they enhance safety for people traveling in the area. This study underscores the significant environmental services provided by large carnivores, demonstrating the importance of coexisting with such majestic species for community well-being.
